q: Do metalworking coolants count in our carbon footprint?
title: Metalworking coolant emissions
short: Coolant concentrate you buy is Scope 3 Category 1, and spent coolant sent to a recycler or treatment plant is Category 5. Coolant does not burn in normal use, so it adds nothing to Scope 1. Longer sump life cuts both lines.

ul: Litres of spent coolant sent out, with the recycler's receipt.

p: For most machine shops coolant is small next to electricity. Track it so the inventory is complete, not because it is large.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
